Dagur Asgeirsson said:

Now only some errors towards the end of the TwoTruncated file need to be fixed. The issue is that ReflQuiv.adj was refactored.

@Marcelo Lynch and Claude have bumped mathlib further (on the same PR). But the sorries remain. Who's the expert in the TwoTruncated file?

Hi! Now that the repo is close to the tip of mathlib again, I think it might be worth incorporating the downstream-reports automation.

cosmos#171 is this change. The new automation replaces the current one (which is opening PRs like cosmos#170 and issues like cosmos#132): the behavior is similar but richer: when there is a breaking change in mathlib, the opened issue
will say exactly which (mathlib) commit is the one that introduced the break, and the repo will also get a PR bumping to that exact commit (which shouldn't be merged -- it's meant to produce a branch that one can check out and fix in place).

Here are examples of this from FLT:

  • FLT#1004 ('bump to latest' when the latest is compatible)
  • FLT#1007 ('bump mathlib ... fix breaking changes') - notice the manual intervention here, and the description pointing to the culprit
  • FLT#1008 - the associated issue when something breaks
